title: Chapter 489
paragraphs: Chapter 489
Episode 136. The Situation at the 2nd Horse Tower
"Kyah! He just looked at me, he saw me! Ehehe, kyahaha!"
"...You were quietly smiling and maintaining a sort of dignity just a moment ago, miss. Do you really have to laugh like a mad person every time?"
"But Jin just looked at me!"
"Thoroughly checking one's surroundings during infiltration is a natural thing to do. He didn't look back at you."
"And it's been so long since we last saw each other, hasn't it?"
"Less than a month has passed since you first and last met Jin Runcandel. I suppose that could be considered a long time if you think it is."
"Jin must be glad to see me too, right?"
"Strictly speaking, you didn't actually meet him, you're just secretly watching him. Jin Runcandel doesn't know that you're sticking your face into the crystal ball with such an excited expression."
"How much did he miss me to come all this way to find me?"
"Miss, Jin Runcandel came here not to see you but to harm your family."
"Oh, Jin just left District 6! Is this the next district's crystal ball? No, is it that one!? I don't want to miss that handsome face for even a second. Hedo, Hedo!"

"The one behind you is the next district's crystal ball. And what kind of face are you seeing, exactly? I can only see a black mask. It's even hard to tell who Jin Runcandel is since we can't hear his voice."
"Hehe, but I can see it all."
"Please, get a grip, miss...."
Hedo's gaze fell on Sandra's right arm.
To be precise, it was a prosthetic. She was actually wearing a prosthetic made of gold without recovering her right arm, which was cut off by Jin.

Moreover, she had even engraved Jin's face on the inside of her forearm, and the walls of Sandra's room were filled with Jin-related things, all the way to the ceiling. Like advertisement flyers and clipped newsletters.
As the second-ranked butler and Sandra's exclusive butler, how could he not sigh at the sight of her like this?
"Phew."
In the end, Hedo finished off ten cigarettes in one sitting from where he was seated.

It had been like this ever since that day. Sandra had been talking nonstop about Jin without taking a single break during her waking hours, putting all the major and minor affairs of the family aside.
He felt like his hair would fall out from the extreme stress.
"Miss."
"Shh, be quiet. Jin is moving so fast, I need to concentrate."
"Sandra, miss."
"Ah, what!"
"You must report this."
"What report?"
"You must report to the head of the family that Jin Runcandel has come to the construction site. After all, you are on duty now."
Sandra looked at Hedo with wide eyes for the first time.
And then she said this.
"Hedo, if I do that, my husband will die. Or he will no longer be Jin."
"Perhaps so. Well, considering the survival skills the 12th flagbearer has shown so far, we can't be sure."
"Don't ever talk such nonsense again."
Hedo hadn't expected much from this conversation in the first place. He knew that his young lady would react like this.
He had just tried to say something out of desperation.
"If you do that again, I'll rip your mouth open. Not vertically, but in a cross. Don't break my happiness. Understand?"
"Yes, yes. How could I be so careless?"
"It just won't do."
"It's better if you just don't. If you're not going to report it, just stay still. I have nothing to say to the head of the family this time either."
"I need to go see Jin!"
The two were in the tower master's office of the 2nd Horse Tower.

When Zipple built the secret construction site, he deliberately chose the Sota Desert near the 2nd Horse Tower. It was so he could monitor the construction site like this through the crystal balls. It was an ideal location to keep a perfect watch on everything, including technology leaks.
Now, as Jin had anticipated, Zipple had used the construction site as bait to check the power and abilities of external forces, but it wasn't originally intended for that purpose.
If Kinzelo hadn't revealed himself, and there hadn't been any suspicion about Joshua using an unidentified ability, the construction site wouldn't have been used up like this.
While Sandra rummaged through the office wardrobe, Hedo looked closely at the row of crystal balls, touching his forehead.
Almost all the areas were being attacked simultaneously. Kinzelo's subordinates and members were running wild, and Joshua's party could also be seen.
Hedo paid particular attention to Jin's group's movements.
'...It doesn't seem like they're trying to search the four areas that were deliberately leaked.'
Their movements were too complicated.
If their intention was to destroy the construction site and only check the important areas, they should have moved in the shortest path since the moment Kinzelo started the terror.

'But Jin Runcandel seems to be planning his route as if he's trying to inspect the entire internal situation, like someone who doesn't know about the 4th, 11th, 17th, and 19th areas. Could it be that the 2nd flagbearer didn't share that fake information... No, wait.'
Something was off.
This time, it wasn't about Jin, but about Kinzelo.
'Among those destroying the construction site, not a single one of Kinzelo's top executives can be seen.'

Even when examining the monitoring spheres of all the areas, no one who seemed to be the top executives was visible. There were no figures like Berakht or Bishkel, and most of them were assault commanders.
At that moment, Hedo perfectly grasped the situation.

'Kinzelo didn't just come to destroy the construction site. They used the terrorist attack on the construction site to attract attention, while the real key players were targeting somewhere else. Where the real information is.'
Right here, at the Tower of White Nights.
They wouldn't target Drakka unless they were insane.
Once Hedo was certain of Kinzelo's intentions, Jin's movements also made sense.
'Jin Runcandel is also targeting this place. And he's calculating when to infiltrate the 2nd Tower to make the best use of Kinzelo!'
Having read the invaders' objectives and numbers, it was time to respond.

"Hedo, how about this shirt and coat? It's a special order with a golden butterfly emblem on the top, and according to our subordinates, this is exactly our taste. They explained in detail how close they are with him. I was so jealous I almost killed them."
"Miss, how many troops did you send for support earlier?"
"What do you think about the clothes!"
"You're beautiful, so please tell me how many magicians from the Tower you sent to support the construction site."
"I sent them all."
"… I must have misheard. Can you please say it again?"
"I thought having the magicians from the Tower come up to the office and make a fuss would interfere with my husband's appreciation, so I just told them all to leave."
"Even the emergency standby personnel?"
"Yes!"
"What about the space-time device..."
"Remember, that was destroyed by those guys from the Gaipa Army."
"Ah, right."
"Stupid!"
Ping-! Hedo's muscles swelled even more, and the buttons on his shirt flew off. When he felt extreme stress or anger, his muscles tended to swell.
However, the reason he was so angry wasn't because of Sandra's innocent answer. The first reason was the broken space-time device, and the second reason was the behavior of the Phantom Troops.
'No matter how it's the Miss's order, the Phantom Troops... Their judgment is just that poor?'
It couldn't be.
The Phantom Troops underestimated Sandra. Sandra's order would have sounded irrational and bizarre to anyone, so they should have at least come to him for confirmation.
'Octavia Zipple, that bastard looks down on her, and even the lower ones treat her like a fool and treat her like this.'
As Hedo thought, his shirt completely tore apart, revealing his 'enormous' physique.
Anyone who saw it once would never forget the muscles that had broken through their limits multiple times, undoubtedly the strongest on Earth, possessing both indescribable strength and beauty.
'I guess I'll have to give them a warning.'
Hedo gritted his teeth, while Sandra hummed a tune.

"Anyway, the clothes are beautiful, right? It seems like it's the first time Hedo praised something like that since he was five years old. So, should I choose this? Kyahaha, what if Jin falls for me!? Let's go, Jin! Just wait a little... Eugh!"
Hedo grabbed the back of Sandra's neck as she was about to dash out.
"What, do you want to die?"
"Miss, you've chosen a nice outfit, but it has too many wrinkles. And your hair is messy."
"Oh, is it?"
"It's always better to maintain a formal appearance. Especially when meeting someone you admire. Please take a bath; I'll iron the clothes and prepare matching accessories."
Hedo gently brushed the dust off Sandra's shoulder.
"What if I miss my husband!? Jin will have to run away soon. Reinforcements will swarm in like cockroaches from Drakka."
"Don't worry, Miss. Jin Runcandel will come here."
"Really? Are you sure?"
"Yes."
"And if he doesn't?"
"If my guess is wrong, I'll catch him myself and escort him here."
Since Hedo had never disappointed her, Sandra immediately nodded.
"Good! It's a good thing I sent everyone away. Our second reunion in an empty tower, how romantic. When Jin comes, Hedo, you leave, okay? I want to spend time alone with him."
Hedo smiled and changed the subject to avoid lying (since Kinzelo and Joshua would also come).
"Miss, before you go to take a bath, please give me the key."
The key Hedo mentioned was for the safe containing the most important items in the 2nd Magic Tower, including the ship's blueprints.
In this situation, it would be much safer to keep the key with him rather than leaving it in the safe.
"Here you go."
Sandra handed over the key that was around her neck.
Then, as if she remembered something, she said to Hedo:

"By the way, Hedo. Before telling me to be formal, you should wear your clothes properly. What's that? It's all torn, and only a few threads and pieces of fabric are barely sticking to your body. Your glasses are crooked too."
Sandra playfully adjusted Hedo's glasses. They were still crooked, but Hedo let out a chuckle.
"I never thought I'd serve someone so shameless and crazy like you."
"That's how it is. Just like I never thought I'd fall in love with Jin."
The two left the room together. Sandra went to the bathroom, and Hedo went to the safe.
'Anyway, Runcandel or Kinzelo, they both have considerable power. I thought they would only focus on the dry dock, but they're aware of this place too...'
As Hedo inserted the key into the safe, he paused, tilting his head.
The sensation of the key entering was unusual, as if someone had already opened the safe today... He felt that kind of discomfort. The key went in too smoothly.
As he quickly opened the safe.
The interior was completely empty, and Hedo couldn't help but put his hand on his forehead again.
